# Getting help with Drift

- **How do I use / install / build Drift?** Ask in
  [Discussions → Q&A](https://github.com/KrishGopi1/Sleep-Project/discussions/categories/q-a).
- **Why does Drift say my debt / need / energy is X?** The app explains every number under
  **Learn → How Drift calculates**. The full methodology is in [docs/science.md](../docs/science.md).
  Still puzzled? Ask in Discussions.
- **Something is broken:** open a [bug report](https://github.com/KrishGopi1/Sleep-Project/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **A calculation looks wrong:** open a
  [scientific issue](https://github.com/KrishGopi1/Sleep-Project/issues/new?template=scientific_issue.yml).
- **Security problem:** see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Please don't post it publicly.

Drift is maintained in spare time, so replies can take a few days.

## Installing

Download the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/KrishGopi1/Sleep-Project/releases/latest), open it
on your phone and allow installing from your browser or file manager when Android asks. Drift needs Android 9
or newer.
